title: Shopify Product & Pricing Feed Extractor
description: Extract normalized product, pricing, variant, and image data from publicly accessible Shopify storefronts. Produces one dataset record per unique product with optional clean Markdown for AI shopping agents.

startUrls.title: Store, collection, or product URLs
startUrls.description: Enter the public Shopify storefront homepage, a collection URL, or individual product URL. Multiple URLs are supported.

maxProducts.title: Maximum products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of unique product records to publish across the entire run.

maxPagesPerStore.title: Maximum pages per store
maxPagesPerStore.description: Maximum total crawled pages per unique store domain, including collection, product, and sitemap pages.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrent requests
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent crawl tasks. Keep this low for responsible storefront extraction.

maxTasksPerMinute.title: Maximum tasks per minute
maxTasksPerMinute.description: Global Crawlee task limit for controlling crawl speed across the run.

includeVariants.title: Include product variants
includeVariants.description: Include publicly available variant IDs, titles, SKUs, options, availability, and prices.

includeMarkdown.title: Include AI-friendly Markdown
includeMarkdown.description: Add a clean, product-specific Markdown representation to each dataset record.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Configure Apify Proxy or authorized custom proxies for reliable public storefront access. Proxy use does not override access restrictions.
